title: Plugin glucose value not pushed to android wear (complication & watchface)
body:
I'm using a calibration plugin and the plugin value is shown on the phone as expected.
On Android Wear 2.x the complication always shows the xdrip+ default value but not the plugin value. The dedicated xdrip watchface is able to show the plugin values, but it's not reliable. After a while it switches back to default (display always on) and it takes another while until it changes back to plugin.
